statement: The proportion of mothers with previous live births differs between SUID cases and live birth groups.
rationale: This design compares the proportions of mothers who have had previous live births between SUID cases (ncfrp_v51) and live birth groups (PRAMS). It cannot estimate incidence rates due to missing denominator data for SUID cases from ncfrp_v51.
prior_art: None in the inputs. The closest claims focus on risk factors like bed sharing, maternal smoking, and prematurity but do not address previous live births.
cannot_establish: incidence rates or causation due to missing denominator data for SUID cases.
